mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that lowers corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 110.0) indicates reduced industrial output and supply chain disruptions that depress corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 110.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payroll employment trend (PAYEMS > 138000) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when PAYEMS > 138000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness that reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle demand slowdown (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%) indicates decelerating consumer and business spending that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
